# Contexts

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Contexts bind a Jira host to a project key and optional defaults, so you
don't repeat `--host` and `--project` on every command.

## jira context create

Create a named context and optionally set it as active.

### Usage

```
jira context create <name> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--host` | | Jira instance base URL |
| `--project` | `-p` | Default project key |
| `--board` | `-b` | Default board ID |
| `--set-active` | | Make this context active immediately |

### Examples

```bash
# Cloud context
jira context create cloud-myorg \
  --host myorg.atlassian.net \
  --project MYPROJ \
  --set-active

# Data Center context
jira context create dc-prod \
  --host jira.example.com \
  --project ABC \
  --board 10 \
  --set-active
```

---

## jira context list

List all configured contexts.

**Alias:** `ls`

### Usage

```
jira context list [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
jira context list
jira context list --json
```

---

## jira context use

Switch the active context.

### Usage

```
jira context use <name> [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
jira context use dc-prod
jira context use cloud-myorg
```

---

## jira context view

Display details for a context.

### Usage

```
jira context view [name] [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
jira context view
jira context view cloud-myorg --json
```

---

## jira context delete

Delete a named context.

### Usage

```
jira context delete <name> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | | Skip confirmation prompt |

### Examples

```bash
jira context delete old-context
jira context delete old-context --confirm
```
